security_audit.summary: Most command and traversal alerts are Markdown formatting or fixed repository links with no dynamic execution. Two external-command findings are confirmed because the workflow directs agents to an unaudited script. The user-derived save path and unrestricted destination retrieval also create high-risk path and network exposure.

remediation.issue: The workflow directs agents to use registry-events.py, but that executable is outside the audited package.
remediation.suggestion: Include and audit the script, define a structured invocation, and require explicit confirmation before it changes shared state.

remediation.issue: The output filename embeds the user-provided offer value without a sanitization requirement.
remediation.suggestion: Convert the offer to a restricted filename slug, reject separators and traversal tokens, and verify the resolved path stays under the output directory.

remediation.issue: The workflow reads an arbitrary destination URL without network-boundary validation.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only HTTP and HTTPS, block loopback and private addresses, revalidate redirects, and require confirmation before accessing unusual hosts.

content.value_statement: Paid media teams need varied copy that matches destination claims and platform limits. This skill creates structured ad variants with angle, claim, and policy checks.
actual_capabilities: Generates RSA headlines and descriptions within the included format limits.
Builds three or more distinct advertising angles with hooks and copy variants.
Maps each ad unit to a supporting claim on the destination page.
Creates hooks and text assets for Search, Meta feeds, and short-form video.
Flags unsupported claims, restricted wording, trademarks, and sensitive-category risks.
Iterates existing creative while preserving stated winners and brand voice.
limitations: Does not score ad-account performance or calculate return on ad spend.
Does not upload, activate, or manage campaigns in advertising platforms.
Needs a destination URL or supplied page claims for reliable message matching.
Platform format limits can change and require verification before import.

use_cases.title: Launch a responsive search ad
use_cases.description: Create a complete RSA asset set that reflects the offer and destination-page claims.

use_cases.title: Plan paid-social creative tests
use_cases.description: Develop distinct angles and hooks for structured audience and message experiments.

use_cases.title: Refresh weak client copy
use_cases.description: Keep proven variants, replace weak units, and document the claim behind each revision.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Google RSA set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create 15 RSA headlines and 4 descriptions for [offer]. Match claims on [destination URL] and flag unsupported wording.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a complete Search asset set for one offer.

prompt_templates.title: Build a social angle matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Build three angles with three hooks each for [audience] on [platform]. Use [destination URL] as the message-match source.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare distinct paid-social concepts for testing.

prompt_templates.title: Replace weak variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [existing variants] and [performance notes]. Keep proven winners, replace weak units, preserve brand voice, and identify each supporting destination claim.
prompt_templates.scenario: Iterate a campaign using manually supplied performance evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a cross-platform test plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create Search and paid-social variants for [offer], [audience], and [markets]. Separate exploratory claims, note policy risks, and define angle-level test hypotheses.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate advanced creative development across formats and markets.

output_examples.input: Create an RSA set for a project tool offering a 14-day trial.
output: Headline: Plan Projects in One Place
Description: Organize tasks and timelines with a 14-day trial.
Message match: Each unit reflects the supplied trial and planning claims.

output_examples.input: Build three paid-social angles for an appointment scheduling service.
output: Benefit angle: Book appointments without email exchanges.
Pain angle: Stop losing time to scheduling conflicts.
Objection angle: Let clients choose from approved time slots.
Policy note: Verify every operational claim against the destination page.

output_examples.input: Refresh weak headlines while keeping the two supplied winners.
output: Retained: The two headlines marked as proven winners.
Replaced: Weak variants with distinct benefit, pain, and proof concepts.
Review flag: Proof claims without a supplied source remain unpublished.

best_practices: Provide the exact destination URL, target platform, audience, and offer details.
Supply approved claims, evidence sources, brand voice, and known policy restrictions.
Verify current platform limits and review every flagged claim before campaign import.
anti_patterns: Do not request guarantees, statistics, testimonials, or prices without supporting evidence.
Do not copy competitor creative from transparency libraries.
Do not publish exploratory or flagged claims as approved advertising copy.

faq.question: Which advertising formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It covers Google RSA, Performance Max text assets, Meta feed copy, and short-form video hooks.

faq.question: Is a landing page required?
faq.answer: A destination page or supplied page claims are required for reliable message matching.

faq.question: Can it upload or activate campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It produces creative drafts and handoff materials but does not activate advertising accounts.

faq.question: Does it guarantee platform policy approval?
faq.answer: No. It flags common claim and policy risks, but platform review and specialist approval remain necessary.

faq.question: Can it use existing campaign performance?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a manual creative export or summarized performance notes to guide iteration.

faq.question: How are unsupported claims handled?
faq.answer: Unsupported claims receive a source-needed flag and are excluded from publish-ready use.
